description: Add up the boxes (casillas) of the Spanish quarterly VAT return Modelo 303 with the formulas printed on the official AEAT form: 27, 45, 46, 64, 66, 87, 69 and 71. Input are the tax amounts (cuotas) per box, e.g. {"09": 17430, "29": 9870}. It only sums what it is given: it does not decide which rate or deduction applies and it is not a tax return.
name: calculate_modelo_303
title: Sum the Spanish VAT return (Modelo 303)
